business_summary: Super Telecom Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides communication, ICT, and new energy services in China. The company offers telecommunication technology services, including communication engineering and maintenance, network optimization, and IoT maintenance services; intelligent hardware, such as full-band NB-IoT chip, communication modules, small cell, smart meters, and fire control hardware; and IoT solutions comprising intelligent water utilities, gas, energy, fire control, air conditioning control, logistics, manufacture, retail, and agriculture, as well as smart street lamps and elevator safety monitoring solutions. It is also involved in the new energy services comprising design, survey, NDRC report, and grid connection of photovoltaic small cells, including photovoltaic small cells and track lighting systems; energy storage application products, including container standard cabinet based on lithium batteries; and backup power applications. In addition, the company offers micro-power wireless IoT and LoRa/NB-IoT modules; cloud platform services; energy-saving goods; and emission reduction and energy management solutions. Further, it engages in computing power; manufacture of computer, communication, and other electronic equipment; internet and related services; research and experimental development; construction and installation; AI; energy technology technical services; software and information technology; and technology promotion and application services. The company serves the e-commerce, logistics, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, finance, and civil service industries. The company was formerly known as GuangDong Super Telecom Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Super Telecom Co.,Ltd in May 2019. Super Telecom Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
